piezime: Assembly points from annex 12 of the shared Liepāja–DKN plan (2026): 40 rows for Dienvidkurzemes novads. The kit's folder only had pointer stubs for this annex, so the text was taken from the official PDF (https://faili.liepaja.lv/CAP/12.-Pielikums.-Pulcēšanās-vietas-un-evakuācijas-koridori-Liepājas-un-DKN-STCAK-2026.pdf, sha256 fca5ea92e1da…, text layer) into liepaja-12-pielikums-2026.md. No coordinates in the annex: places geocoded with the VZD address register. Accommodation is still not public (the plan's annex 7 is vehicles, not accommodation). Previously: All files in this folder (incl. annex 12 'pulcēšanās vietas') are pointer stubs with no content: Dienvidkurzeme shares the Liepāja–Dienvidkurzeme cooperation-territory CA plan (Liepajas-DKN-ST-CAP), whose full conversion is in markdown/liepaja/. Extract lists from the liepaja slug.
